name: Iconify
category: A4. Vector, typography, diagrams and stills
role: Offline icon data for 280+ open sets as SVG, with per-set licence and author metadata
summary: @iconify/json bundles every open icon set as JSON with each set's SPDX licence and author; @iconify/utils turns an icon into SVG offline. Its strength is a machine-readable licence per set, so a credits or licence check can gate icons before they enter a scene.
use_when: Icons or logos as SVG layers where the licence must be checked or credited
Reproducible renders: icon data is local and pinned, no live API
Picking one icon from a very large mixed-style library by set and name
avoid_when: Editing, optimising or rasterising SVG once you have it: svg, svgo, resvg
Icons from one known set only: install that set's own package instead of 730 MB of data
Brand logos where trademark terms matter: a CC0 set does not clear the mark
notes: 2026-11-27: Tooling is MIT; each icon set keeps its own licence. Of 281 sets in @iconify/json 2.2.562: 184 notice-retained (MIT, ISC, Apache-2.0, BSD-3), 68 attribution-required (CC-BY, OFL), 11 free (CC0, Unlicense), 10 share-alike review (CC-BY-SA, MPL-2.0), 6 GPL (gridicons, wordpress, dashicons, gala, icomoon-free, et) and 2 non-commercial (cbi, ps).
2026-11-27: @iconify/json publishes almost daily and installs about 730 MB; pin the exact version and prefer the local JSON over api.iconify.design.

assessment.rationale: @iconify/json 2.2.562 and @iconify/utils 3.1.7 (both MIT) installed and read locally; repository pushed 2026-11-21. Nothing catalogued supplies icons with machine-readable licence metadata; svg, svgo and resvg only handle SVG you already have. Set licences vary, including GPL and non-commercial sets, so use must be gated per set.

evidence.result: 3 icons (ISC, CC-BY-4.0, CC0) built offline to SVG, identical SHA-256 across two Node 22.19.0 processes; all 281 set licences classified, 0 unknown; resvg 192 px PNGs inspected.
evidence.scope: Local JSON and utils only: 3 icons, height and colour options, one data release, macOS arm64; not the live API, @iconify/tools, palette icons, or legal sufficiency of a licence.
